# Littlest Galleries

> Littlest Galleries is a small London studio run by Brooke, an American mum of two living in London. She hand-makes bespoke framed collages from children's own drawings, paintings and handprints, for families across the UK.

## What it is
- A one-of-a-kind collage made by hand from a child's own artwork (paintings, drawings, crayon, watercolour, felt-tip, handprints, mixed media).
- Artwork from two or more siblings can be combined into one piece, or made as a matching pair.
- Framed pieces come in a light oak floating frame, ready to hang. Unused artwork is returned.
- Brooke takes on two commissions a week.

## Prices (GBP, include insured UK delivery)
- 24×30 inches: £640 framed, £445 unframed (send 40+ pieces of art)
- 30×40 inches: £835 framed, £590 unframed (send 50+ pieces of art)
- 36×48 inches: £1,010 framed, £745 unframed (send 60+ pieces of art)
- Custom sizes on request. Gift vouchers available.

## How ordering works
1. Enquire through the form on the website (no payment needed to ask), or book a delivery week with a 75% deposit.
2. Post the artwork to Brooke's London studio so it arrives at least 2 weeks before the delivery week. The studio address is emailed after booking.
3. Brooke makes the collage by hand. The remaining 25% is due before dispatch, then it is delivered, insured, across the UK.

## Where
- Studio: London, United Kingdom. Delivers across the UK; outside the UK on request.

## Reviews
- "It's an incredible piece and my girls are absolutely mesmerised by seeing their own art on display." (Valentina, May 2026)
